findings.description: none: WAIT policy honors wait_if_budget_exceeded per roadmap-orchestration 'Wait policy selected under budget constraints'. _handle_vendor_limit short-circuits on PolicyAction.WAIT before any registry/fallback lookup (lanes=()), and select_registry_lane returns _evaluate_wait before the switch-attempt branch, so no alternate lane is selected (test asserts registry_calls == [] and to_agent_id is None). The wait branch persists pause_state {paused, reason, paused_at, blocked_vendor, expected_resume_at} via mgr.save and returns False without _fail, so the item is not failed and the checkpoint phase stays at the paused phase; execute_roadmap breaks out of the item loop on pause_state.paused (no spin, exactly one dispatch of the paused phase). On re-entry _pause_is_active refuses redispatch while now < expected_resume_at (or indefinitely when no reset is known, matching 'until the known reset window'); once elapsed it clears pause_state, saves, and resumes at checkpoint.phase for the same item because current_item_id matches. Persisted keys match openspec/schemas/checkpoint.schema.json pause_state. SWITCH is unchanged: the non-WAIT path still enforces max_switch_attempts_per_item and retries the exact phase with selected_agent_id. Covered by test_wait_policy_persists_pause_and_does_not_retry_or_select_lane and test_registry_lane_selection_honors_wait_policy_without_selecting_lane.

none: Watchdog persist_probe failure satisfies vendor-registry 'Snapshot write fails' and D10. The existing logger.error line is retained, and the failure is now durably audited through VendorRegistryService.audit_probe_persistence_failure -> _audit_event with operation vendor_probe_persistence_failed, parameters {target_agent_id: <exact lane>}, result {status: 'failed', reason: 'probe_persistence_failed'}, success=False. The reason is a stable constant; the raw exception text (which could carry a DSN) is not placed in the durable record. The audit call is wrapped in its own try/except that only logs, and both try blocks are inside the per-vendor loop, so an audit backend outage cannot stop sibling snapshots or the vendor.unavailable/vendor.recovered transition pass. Covered by test_snapshot_failure_is_audited_without_suppressing_siblings, test_snapshot_audit_failure_does_not_suppress_siblings_or_transition, and test_probe_persistence_failure_audit_identifies_lane_and_reason.

none: Persisted pause_state strings are sanitized at the checkpoint boundary with the canonical roadmap-runtime sanitizer, per 'Validate sanitization on checkpoint writes'. _persist_policy_pause now assigns sanitize_dict(pause_state) before mgr.save, which routes reason and blocked_vendor through sanitize_string. The existing _SENSITIVE_PATTERNS handle token=/api_key= forms, and the new _PROHIBITED_STRING_PATTERN redacts embedded raw_response/raw_prompt/auth_header/session_token/credentials/env_value fragments from the marker to end of string (DOTALL), so no upstream payload survives after the marker. ISO timestamps in paused_at/expected_resume_at are not matched by any pattern, so _pause_is_active still parses them on resume. In-memory behaviour is untouched: the PolicyDecision and policy_decisions entry retain the raw reason (test asserts secret_reason is present in result but absent from checkpoint.json). Covered by test_wait_pause_sanitizes_adapter_reason_only_at_persistence_boundary and test_redacts_embedded_prohibited_raw_response.
